title: Use a storyboard workflow in Seedance 2.0 by breaking the video into multiple…
content: Use a storyboard workflow in Seedance 2.0 by breaking the video into multiple boards/scenes and generating each board separately.
tips: Use a storyboard workflow in Seedance 2.0 by breaking the video into multiple boards/scenes and generating each board separately.
